Keywords: floating, pill, minimal, rounded, compact, sticky, glassmorphism
Best For: Modern SaaS, design studios, portfolios, sites with < 5 navigation links.
Layout Structure: Fixed/sticky floating container centered horizontally with max-w-4xl, rounded-full, px-6 py-2.5, backdrop-blur-md.
Typography Specs: Links: text-sm font-medium tracking-normal. Brand: text-sm font-semibold or monospaced icon.
Key Components: Logo, 3-5 links, compact pill primary CTA button.
Responsive Behavior: Collapses to pill with logo + compact hamburger trigger; drawer expands downwards as floating card.
Accessibility: role='navigation', aria-label='Primary Navigation', 2px focus ring with 2px offset.
Anti-Slop Rules: No screaming gradient borders, no 50px excessive blurs that lag scroll performance.

Keywords: full-width, enterprise, clean, border-bottom, traditional, corporate
Best For: B2B SaaS, enterprise platforms, professional agencies with 5-8 primary links.
Layout Structure: Full-width w-full h-16 sm:h-20 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--surface-base)]/90 backdrop-blur-sm px-6 lg:px-12 flex items-center justify-between.
Typography Specs: Links: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-[var(--text-primary)].
Key Components: Brand logo, center navigation links with subtle underline indicator on active, right button group (Login + Primary CTA).
Responsive Behavior: Desktop flex row; mobile displays right-side slide-over sheet (BottomSheet / Drawer).
Accessibility: Skip-to-content link preceding header; keyboard tab sequence preserved.
Anti-Slop Rules: No raw emoji navigation items, no animated gradient text.

Best For: Agencies with deep services (SEO, PPC, Web Dev, Branding) and rich content resources.
Layout Structure: Full-width header with relative dropdown triggers opening 2-column or 3-column structured flyout cards with feature highlights.
Typography Specs: Category headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Item titles: text-sm font-semibold.
Key Components: Category icons (20x20 SVG), descriptive micro-copy per link, featured case study badge in right column.
Responsive Behavior: Mobile transforms to nested collapsible accordion list with chevron indicators.
Accessibility: aria-expanded, aria-haspopup='true', Escape key closes active dropdown, arrow keys navigate items.
Anti-Slop Rules: No multi-level cascading 3-tier sub-dropdowns that fail hover intent.

Keywords: lead-gen, emergency, phone, direct-action, high-converting, local-b2b
Best For: Lead generation agencies, local B2B, performance marketing where direct phone/call action is priority #1.
Layout Structure: Left logo, middle confidence badge ('Avg Response: 15 mins' with green pulse dot), right click-to-call + booking CTA.
Typography Specs: Phone: text-sm font-mono font-semibold. CTA: text-sm font-bold.
Key Components: Status indicator dot, phone icon + number link, high-contrast consultation CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Sticky bottom bar appears on mobile with click-to-call and quick inquiry button.
Accessibility: tel: schema formatted correctly, phone target min 44x44px touch target.
Anti-Slop Rules: No obnoxious blinking animations; use subtle CSS opacity transition.

Keywords: editorial, minimal, hamburger, luxury, fashion, fullscreen-overlay
Best For: Awwwards-style creative studios, luxury brands, editorial agencies prioritizing visual canvas.
Layout Structure: Top corner logo and top corner minimal menu trigger ('MENU' / 2-line icon); opens full-viewport modal overlay.
Typography Specs: Overlay links: text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight hover:italic transition-all.
Key Components: Minimal trigger, full-page overlay with social links and office locations in bottom grid.
Responsive Behavior: Unified interaction across desktop and mobile.
Accessibility: Focus trapped inside modal when open, body scroll locked, aria-modal='true'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Maintain quick dismiss button; never hide close button off-screen.

Best For: Large agencies, international businesses with language switchers, client portals, and secondary links.
Layout Structure: Top tier (h-9, subtle bg, text-xs links, client portal login, language switch) + Main tier (h-16, logo, main links, primary CTA).
Typography Specs: Top tier: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]. Main tier: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Language selector, portal login link, phone number, main nav links, primary CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Top tier hidden on mobile; essential actions consolidated into mobile menu drawer.
Accessibility: Two separate <nav> regions with distinct aria-labels ('Utility Navigation' and 'Primary Navigation').
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep top tier strictly secondary; do not crowd with duplicate CTA buttons.

Best For: B2B SaaS, digital agencies with concrete deliverables or dashboard software.
Layout Structure: 2-column asymmetric grid (lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12); Left col (7 cols) text & CTAs; Right col (5 cols) interactive or framed mockup.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight. Subhead: text-lg sm:text-xl text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Metadata chip badge, primary CTA + secondary ghost button, avatar trust strip, aspect-ratio reserved mockup container.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with text top, mockup below. Container reserves min-height to prevent CLS.
Accessibility: Semantic H1, descriptive alt on mockup or aria-hidden='true' if decorative.
Anti-Slop Rules: No purple gradient blobs behind mockup; use grounded border and subtle dark surface.

Keywords: centered, big-type, minimalist, copy-first, bold, high-impact
Best For: Consultancies, design studios, strategic marketing firms with strong punchy messaging.
Layout Structure: Centered single column max-w-4xl mx-auto py-24 sm:py-32 text-center flex flex-col items-center.
Typography Specs: H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.08]. Subhead: text-lg sm:text-xl max-w-2xl mt-6.
Key Components: Category eyebrow tag, massive H1, centered dual CTA buttons, client logo strip below.
Responsive Behavior: Dynamic fluid typography using clamp() or responsive Tailwind steps (`text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl`).
Accessibility: High contrast ratio (min 7:1 for hero typography on dark or light background).
Anti-Slop Rules: No rainbow gradient text fill; use solid white or high-contrast slate.

Best For: Video agencies, 3D studios, creative event productions, luxury lifestyle brands.
Layout Structure: Full-height min-h-[85vh] relative flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden; background video with 50-70% dark scrim.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white. Subhead: text-lg text-slate-200.
Key Components: Compressed webm/mp4 video loop, mute/pause accessibility toggle button in bottom corner, high-contrast white CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Fallback high-res static poster image on mobile or low-power mode.
Accessibility: Mute by default, prefers-reduced-motion pause, accessible play/pause control.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never autoplay sound; video must be under 3MB compressed.

Best For: SEO agencies (Website URL Audit), PPC agencies (Ad Spend Calculator), high-velocity lead gen.
Layout Structure: Centered or split layout with an oversized single-field input group embedded directly under the subhead.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold. Input placeholder: text-base text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: URL / Email input field with embedded submit button ('Run Free Audit $\to$'), trust bullet points below input.
Responsive Behavior: Desktop inline horizontal input + button; mobile stacks input and full-width button.
Accessibility: Explicit <label> (visually hidden if needed with sr-only), aria-describedby for error state.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not request 8 form fields in hero; strict 1-field rule.

Best For: AI agencies, multi-faceted growth platforms, tech-forward product agencies.
Layout Structure: Top headline row + asymmetric 4-tile bento grid directly below (1 large interactive card, 2 metric cards, 1 review card).
Typography Specs: Tile headers: text-base font-semibold. Metric numbers: text-3xl font-mono font-bold.
Key Components: Mini chart widget, testimonial snippet tile, interactive toggle card, live status badge.
Responsive Behavior: Grid shifts from 3 columns desktop to 2 columns tablet to single vertical column mobile.
Accessibility: Each bento tile is an independent article/section with appropriate heading levels.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake glowing purple outlines; use solid 1px border with surface hover lift.

Best For: Mobile app developers, cross-platform agencies showcasing UI across phone, tablet, and desktop.
Layout Structure: Centered text on top, floating overlapping device frames (iPhone + iPad + Mac) resting on horizontal shelf below.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold text-center.
Key Components: SVG device bezels, screenshots with realistic shadows, subtle hover tilt.
Responsive Behavior: On small screens, secondary devices fade away leaving only the primary mobile phone frame.
Accessibility: Alt text describing what is shown on screen; interactive slider buttons keyboard accessible.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure realistic bezel dimensions, no skewed funhouse 3D distortion.

Best For: Competitive markets, B2B agencies where trust is the #1 friction point for buyers.
Layout Structure: Avatar stack + 5-star rating widget positioned *above* the main headline; H1 centered below, followed by video quote preview.
Typography Specs: Proof banner: text-xs font-semibold. H1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-bold.
Key Components: Avatar overlap row (4 real photos), star rating SVG cluster, verified review count text, dual CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Avatars scale down gracefully, headline wraps without orphans.
Accessibility: aria-label='Rated 4.9 out of 5 stars by over 300 verified clients'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Real human headshots only; no generic AI-generated stock avatars.

Keywords: editorial, swiss, asymmetrical, serif, high-fashion, architectural
Best For: Architecture firms, luxury branding studios, editorial magazines, high-end strategy firms.
Layout Structure: Left narrow rail (3 cols) containing project metadata, date, index, and location; Right wide rail (9 cols) with giant typography and single large photograph.
Typography Specs: Left rail: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest. Main title: text-5xl sm:text-7xl font-serif italic/regular mix.
Key Components: Monospaced index indicators, thin 1px dividing rules, high-contrast monochrome palette.
Responsive Behavior: Left rail stacks on top as an eyebrow badge bar on mobile.
Accessibility: Strict semantic heading levels; high contrast ratio exceeding 7:1.
Anti-Slop Rules: No rounded button bubbles; sharp 0px or 2px radius strictly enforced.

Best For: Next-gen tech startups, WebGL creative agencies, hardware/AI ventures.
Layout Structure: Left floating content card; right full-bleed interactive 3D model reacting to pointer move.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-mono or modern geometric sans.
Key Components: Canvas container with loading fallback, interactive 3D object, pointer inertia listener.
Responsive Behavior: 3D canvas disabled or replaced with static SVG/WebP preview on low-power/mobile devices.
Accessibility: Skip button for keyboard users; canvas marked aria-hidden='true' with text equivalent.
Anti-Slop Rules: Must maintain 60 FPS; fall back to WebP on mobile to prevent phone overheating.

Best For: Performance agencies, conversion rate optimizers, turnaround consultancies.
Layout Structure: Centered value proposition with dual split cards directly below: Left card 'The Old Way' (muted/grey), Right card 'The Agency Way' (vibrant/highlighted).
Typography Specs: Card headers: text-sm font-mono uppercase. Bullets: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Red cross icons vs green checkmark icons, contrast metrics, direct booking CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Side-by-side on desktop, stacks with 'The Old Way' first, 'The Agency Way' second on mobile.
Accessibility: Screen reader text distinguishes problem list from solution list clearly.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep comparison factual and quantitative; avoid dramatic hyperbole.

Best For: Agencies with 8 to 20+ recognizable client logos.
Layout Structure: Full-width overflow-hidden relative py-8 border-y border-[var(--border-subtle)]; CSS translateX animation running continuously.
Typography Specs: Section title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-center mb-6 text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: CSS keyframe continuous marquee, left and right linear gradient fade masks (mask-image).
Responsive Behavior: Same layout on mobile; speed adjusted slightly for small viewport width.
Accessibility: Pause on hover and pause when prefers-reduced-motion is active.
Anti-Slop Rules: All logos normalized to single monochrome color (slate-400/500) and equal visual height (24-32px).

Best For: High-end agencies with 4 to 8 prestigious blue-chip client logos.
Layout Structure: max-w-6xl mx-auto grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-8 items-center justify-items-center py-12.
Typography Specs: Title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Static SVG logos with 50% opacity, transitioning to 100% on individual logo hover.
Responsive Behavior: Neat 2-column or 3-column grid on mobile; zero overflow.
Accessibility: Each logo has descriptive alt text (e.g., 'Stripe logo').
Anti-Slop Rules: Never use rainbow colored logos; strict single-tint saturation.

Best For: B2B performance agencies where client logos need immediate proof backing.
Layout Structure: Grid of 3 or 4 cards; each card contains the client logo at top and a bold result stat below (e.g., '+180% Inbound SQLs').
Typography Specs: Stat: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Description: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Client SVG logo, metric badge, 1-line case study link.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal carousel or 1-column stack on mobile.
Accessibility: Screen reader announces: 'Client Stripe achieved 180% inbound growth'.
Anti-Slop Rules: All stats must be verifiable, no fabricated round numbers.

Archetype Name: Press & Media Mentions with Pull Quotes
Keywords: press, media, forbes, techcrunch, quotes, authority
Best For: Startups and agencies featured in major publications.
Layout Structure: Row of 3 publication logos (TechCrunch, Forbes, Bloomberg); clicking or viewing shows the exact pull quote beneath.
Typography Specs: Quote: text-sm sm:text-base font-serif italic text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Publication logo, italic quote snippet, external verification link.
Responsive Behavior: Stacked vertically on mobile with divider lines.
Accessibility: External links have aria-label and rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake press badges without real article citations.

Best For: Design agencies where each client logo links directly to their case study.
Layout Structure: Row of client logos; hovering a logo displays a dynamic floating preview card of the website built for them.
Typography Specs: Hover card title: text-sm font-semibold. Category: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: SVG logo button, floating tooltip/popover preview card with project thumbnail.
Responsive Behavior: On touch devices, tap opens the case study directly without hover state.
Accessibility: Full keyboard focus reveals preview card, Esc closes.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep preview card render lightweight; preload images.

Keywords: security, compliance, soc2, iso, gdpr, hipaa, trust
Best For: Fintech, healthtech, and enterprise software agencies requiring formal security validation.
Layout Structure: Side-by-side dual strip: Left client brand logos; Right formal compliance seals (SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR).
Typography Specs: Badges label: text-xs font-mono font-semibold text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400.
Key Components: Security shield icons, verification date badge, audit report link.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into two distinct sub-sections on mobile.
Accessibility: Compliance status explicitly declared in aria-description.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not mix playful emojis with formal compliance seals.

Keywords: founder-story, letter, signature, boutique, authentic, mission
Best For: Boutique agencies, founder-led studios, high-trust consulting practices.
Layout Structure: 2-column layout: Left column candid high-res founder portrait with location/bio pill; Right column personal manifesto letter with SVG signature.
Typography Specs: Manifesto headline: text-3xl font-serif font-normal. Body: text-base leading-relaxed. Signature: SVG vector.
Key Components: Founder portrait, pull-quote block, handwritten SVG signature, credentials badges.
Responsive Behavior: Portrait stacks above letter on mobile with consistent 24px spacing.
Accessibility: Portrait has descriptive alt text; signature has aria-label='Founder signature'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake AI-generated corporate headshots; real candid photo only.

Best For: Growing agencies (15-50 people) with tangible milestone numbers.
Layout Structure: Left column bold mission statement + core values accordion; Right column 2x2 asymmetric stat card cluster.
Typography Specs: Mission H2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight. Stat numbers: text-4xl font-extrabold.
Key Components: Value bullets with stroke checkmarks, raised surface stat cards with subtle borders.
Responsive Behavior: Grid collapses to single column on mobile.
Accessibility: Headings follow strict H2 -> H3 nesting.
Anti-Slop Rules: No hollow corporate buzzwords ('synergistic paradigm shifts').

Best For: Established agencies celebrating 5 to 15+ years of industry leadership.
Layout Structure: Vertical central spine with alternating year cards (2018 -> 2021 -> 2024 -> Today) showing pivotal pivots.
Typography Specs: Year: text-2xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--color-primary)]. Event title: text-lg font-semibold.
Key Components: Connecting line with node dots, milestone cards, historical photography thumbnails.
Responsive Behavior: Shifts to single left-aligned vertical line on mobile with cards on right.
Accessibility: Timeline ordered sequentially in DOM (<ol> and <li>).
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep entries strictly limited to 4-5 major milestones; do not document every minor date.

Best For: Agencies hiring top talent and pitching clients who value strong team culture.
Layout Structure: Asymmetric bento grid of 5 cards: 3 candid office/workshop photos, 1 core philosophy quote card, 1 team stat card.
Typography Specs: Philosophy text: text-xl font-medium tracking-tight.
Key Components: Rounded image frames (rounded-2xl), subtle inner shadow, location tag badge ('San Francisco & London').
Responsive Behavior: Bento reflows smoothly to 2 columns on tablet, single column on phone.
Accessibility: All images have complete contextual alt tags.
Anti-Slop Rules: Zero generic handshake stock photos.

Best For: Intellectual, high-craft design and development agencies with no photo assets.
Layout Structure: Oversized paragraph text with highlighted keywords, structured into 3 core beliefs (01 / 02 / 03).
Typography Specs: Belief statement: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium leading-relaxed. Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase.
Key Components: Numbered anchors (`01`, `02`, `03`), subtle horizontal rules dividing beliefs.
Responsive Behavior: Fluid responsive font sizing preserving line-length between 45-75 characters.
Accessibility: Meets WCAG 2.2 AA text contrast (min 4.5:1, target 7:1).
Anti-Slop Rules: No purple glowing text highlights; use high-contrast foreground color changes.

Best For: High-end agencies with a produced 60-90 second brand film.
Layout Structure: Left column brief text summary and CTA; Right column 16:9 custom video player with play trigger and runtime badge ('1:20 min').
Typography Specs: H2: text-3xl font-bold. Runtime badge: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Custom video thumbnail with play button overlay, modal video lightbox trigger.
Responsive Behavior: Video player fills full width on mobile.
Accessibility: Closed captions (VTT) provided, accessible video player controls.
Anti-Slop Rules: No autoplaying video with sound; user-initiated only.

Best For: Standard agencies offering 3, 6, or 9 structured services.
Layout Structure: Standard 3-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8`).
Typography Specs: Service title: text-xl font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: SVG icon container (p-3 rounded-xl bg-primary/10), title, 3-bullet deliverables list, 'Learn more $\to$' link.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Cards use semantic <article>, links have descriptive aria-labels.
Anti-Slop Rules: No cartoonish 3D emoji icons; use precision 1.5px stroke SVG icons.

Archetype Name: Interactive Hover List with Floating Image Reveal
Best For: Creative studios, Awwwards-style agencies offering 4 to 8 high-craft services.
Layout Structure: Vertical list of services separated by 1px borders; hovering any item causes a smooth floating preview thumbnail to follow the cursor.
Typography Specs: Service title: text-3xl sm:text-5xl font-light hover:translate-x-3 transition-transform.
Key Components: Cursor-tracking floating image container (fixed pointer-events-none), service number index, category tag.
Responsive Behavior: Floating hover image disabled on touch screens; thumbnail appears statically beneath item title.
Accessibility: Full keyboard focus highlights row and displays thumbnail natively.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure pointer-events-none on floating image so it never blocks click events.

Best For: Agencies with 1 primary flagship service (e.g., SEO/Growth) and 3-4 supporting services.
Layout Structure: Asymmetric 12-column grid: 1 large 7-column card showcasing core service with live diagram, paired with two 5-column satellite cards.
Typography Specs: Flagship title: text-2xl font-bold. Satellite title: text-lg font-semibold.
Key Components: Embedded mini-interactive widget in flagship card, deliverable pills, micro-CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Reflows to single column stack on mobile.
Accessibility: Each bento cell has unique H3 landmark.
Anti-Slop Rules: No shiny purple borders or rainbow gradients on cards.

Best For: Agencies with deep, technical services requiring detailed explanations without making the page too long.
Layout Structure: Top horizontal tab buttons (or left vertical rail); clicking a tab updates the active right panel with deliverables, tech stack, and case study snippet.
Typography Specs: Tab label: text-sm font-semibold. Panel title: text-2xl font-bold.
Key Components: Accessible tab list (`role='tablist'`), active pill indicator with CSS layout transition, deliverables checklist.
Responsive Behavior: Transforms into a vertical accordion on mobile screens for easy thumb tapping.
Accessibility: role='tablist', role='tab', aria-selected='true', left/right arrow key navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure instant state changes (<50ms) without jarring layout shifts.

Best For: Agencies targeting mobile-heavy audiences or showcasing 6+ service packages.
Layout Structure: Full-bleed horizontal scrolling track with snap-mandatory scrolling; navigation arrows on top right.
Typography Specs: Card title: text-xl font-bold. Price tag: text-sm font-mono.
Key Components: Snap-start card containers, left/right arrow buttons, scroll progress indicator bar.
Responsive Behavior: Native touch scroll on mobile with CSS scroll-snap-type: x mandatory.
Accessibility: Keyboard accessible previous/next buttons, aria-roledescription='carousel'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never hijack vertical mousewheel scrolling unless explicitly opted-in.

Best For: Designjoy-style productized agencies with fixed scopes and rapid turnarounds.
Layout Structure: Grid of structured service boxes with 'What's Included' checklist and 'View Full Scope' trigger that opens a Slide-Over Sheet.
Typography Specs: Turnaround badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-500. Title: text-xl font-bold.
Key Components: Turnaround time pill ('48h turnaround'), checkmark scope list, sheet drawer trigger.
Responsive Behavior: Sheet opens full width on mobile.
Accessibility: Focus management inside drawer; Escape key dismisses.
Anti-Slop Rules: Clearly delineate what is NOT included to prevent client scope creep.

Best For: Enterprise IT, technical SEO, and cyber security agencies with exhaustive deliverable matrices.
Layout Structure: Structured data table with sticky header row; service categories on left, deliverable checkmarks and SLAs across columns.
Typography Specs: Headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Cells: text-sm.
Key Components: Checkmarks, SLA tags ('Same-day', 'Weekly'), downloadable PDF scope button.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal overflow scroll container with subtle shadow indicators on table edges.
Accessibility: Strict table markup (<thead>, <tbody>, <th scope='col'>, <th scope='row'>).
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure high-contrast borders; no low-contrast faint grey lines.

Best For: Web3, DevOps, engineering, and API development agencies targeting CTOs.
Layout Structure: Dark simulated terminal window with traffic light buttons (red, yellow, green) and monospaced command outputs detailing agency stack.
Typography Specs: Font: JetBrains Mono or Fira Code, text-sm leading-relaxed.
Key Components: Simulated bash prompt (`$ agency deploy --stack full`), syntax-highlighted service JSON output.
Responsive Behavior: Wraps cleanly with overflow-x-auto on small screens.
Accessibility: role='region', aria-label='Interactive Technical Deliverables Terminal'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake typing animations that take 10 seconds to read; render immediately.

Keywords: icon-grid, feature-cards, four-column, competitive, advantages, benefits
Best For: Agencies with 4-8 distinct competitive advantages expressible with an icon, title, and 2-line description.
Layout Structure: 4-column icon grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Each cell: SVG icon in p-3 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 container, bold title, 2-line descriptor.
Typography Specs: Title: text-lg font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: 24x24 precision SVG icon, titled advantage, short descriptor, optional stat badge.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop. Consistent card heights via CSS grid stretch.
Accessibility: Each feature block is an article with semantic H3 heading.
Anti-Slop Rules: No emoji icons, no purple gradient icon containers; use clean primary-tinted rounded backgrounds.

Best For: Agencies in competitive markets where clients are explicitly comparing multiple vendors.
Layout Structure: 2-column table: left column others do (grey X icons), right column we do (green check icons) with highlighted right column.
Typography Specs: Column header: text-sm font-mono font-bold uppercase. Row text: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Red-tinted competitor column vs vibrant primary-tinted us column, row-by-row contrast, bottom CTA.
Responsive Behavior: On mobile, shows stacked card pair: The Old Way above, Our Way below.
Accessibility: Proper table markup with th scope=col; screen reader announces column headers per row.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep comparisons factual and verifiable; no vague claims without evidence.

Archetype Name: Big Statistic Anchors with Proof Copy
Keywords: stats, big-numbers, proof, metrics, achievements, credibility
Best For: Agencies with compelling quantitative credibility: years in business, clients served, revenue generated.
Layout Structure: Row of 3-4 oversized stat anchors (text-5xl font-black) with descriptor beneath, divider lines between, full-width centered container.
Typography Specs: Stat numeral: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold text-[var(--color-primary)]. Label: text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider.
Key Components: Animated count-up on scroll-enter, verified data footnote, bottom differentiator sentence.
Responsive Behavior: 2x2 grid on mobile, horizontal row on desktop.
Accessibility: aria-label on each stat container reading the full statement.
Anti-Slop Rules: All numbers must be specific and verifiable; no round unqualified numbers.

Best For: High-ticket enterprises where each differentiator requires evidence paragraphs to convert a skeptical buyer.
Layout Structure: Left sticky H2 intro para; Right 5-7 accordion rows each expanding to reveal evidence paragraph, case study snippet, and stat badge.
Typography Specs: Accordion trigger: text-lg font-semibold. Expanded body: text-sm leading-relaxed. Stat badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold.
Key Components: Accordion triggers, smooth height transitions, inline mini-stat badge, evidence paragraph with client attribution.
Responsive Behavior: Left column stacks above accordion on mobile; accordion full-width.
Accessibility: aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard Enter/Space toggles.
Anti-Slop Rules: No generic passion copy; every claim must cite a specific metric or named client.

Best For: Agencies where founder or team video builds significantly more trust than text-based claims.
Layout Structure: Left: 1 large founder video card (16:9) with play button. Right: 3 stacked micro-evidence cards each with 1 bold stat plus 1 sentence proof.
Typography Specs: Stat: text-3xl font-extrabold text-[var(--color-primary)]. Evidence: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Video player card, 3 evidence micro-cards, bottom full story CTA.
Responsive Behavior: Video fills full width on mobile, evidence cards stack below.
Accessibility: Video player has caption (VTT), accessible play/pause control, written transcript link.
Anti-Slop Rules: Video must be real founder or team footage; no stock business meeting clips.

Archetype Name: Award, Certification and Trust Badge Cluster
Keywords: awards, certifications, trust-badges, clutch, google-partner, iso
Best For: Agencies with industry certifications (Google Partner, Meta Partner, Clutch Top 100) that visually validate authority.
Layout Structure: Centered cluster of 3-5 official certification badge cards in a row, each with the official badge SVG, certification name, year awarded, and issuer.
Typography Specs: Badge name: text-sm font-semibold. Issuer: text-xs font-mono. Year: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Official certification SVG badges, award year chips, issuer label, verification link.
Responsive Behavior: Wraps into 2 rows on mobile with consistent card sizes.
Accessibility: Each badge has aria-label describing the certification and year awarded.
Anti-Slop Rules: Only display certifications you actively hold; no expired or unobtained badges.

Best For: Simple 3-4 step linear processes with concise explanations.
Layout Structure: Horizontal 4-column row linked by connecting line with step nodes and directional arrows.
Typography Specs: Step number: text-sm font-mono font-bold text-primary. Title: text-lg font-semibold.
Key Components: Connecting horizontal line, circular step node icons, title, 2-line description.
Responsive Behavior: Converts cleanly to vertical stepper on mobile (`PatternStepper.tsx`).
Accessibility: Wrapped in <ol> and <li> list with aria-label='Process steps'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No neon glowing connector lines; use clean 1px border with primary accent dot.

Best For: 5-6 steps where each stage has deeper storytelling and requires breathing room.
Layout Structure: Central vertical spine line with alternating step cards on left and right.
Typography Specs: Timeline node: text-sm font-mono. Step title: text-xl font-bold.
Key Components: Vertical dashed/solid spine, node badges, alternating content cards.
Responsive Behavior: Spine shifts to left edge on mobile with all content cards aligned right.
Accessibility: DOM order is sequential regardless of left/right visual alternation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Avoid large empty whitespace gaps between alternating cards.

Best For: Clean, corporate, professional agencies wanting uniform balanced layout.
Layout Structure: 2x2 or 4x1 grid of identical structured cards with step pill, icon, title, description.
Typography Specs: Step pill: text-xs font-mono font-semibold. Title: text-lg font-bold.
Key Components: Raised surface cards, 1px subtle borders, icon container, step number badge.
Responsive Behavior: Single column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Standard grid semantics with semantic heading levels.
Anti-Slop Rules: No mismatched card heights; use CSS flex-1 or grid stretch.

Best For: Modern, premium agencies with short, confident copy and high visual impact.
Layout Structure: 4-column grid dominated by giant oversized `01`, `02`, `03`, `04` numerals anchored above minimal titles.
Typography Specs: Numeral: text-6xl sm:text-7xl font-extrabold text-[var(--border-subtle)] hover:text-primary transition-colors.
Key Components: Oversized typography numerals, micro-tag pill, bold title, concise summary.
Responsive Behavior: Numerals scale down gracefully using responsive font sizing.
Accessibility: Numerals marked aria-hidden='true' if redundant to semantic list index.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep numerals legible; do not use unreadable decorative scripts.

Best For: Complex technical processes involving feedback loops, branching, or multiple stakeholders.
Layout Structure: Interactive SVG flowchart showing nodes (Client Input -> AI Analysis -> Human Craft -> QA Audit) with active signal pulses.
Typography Specs: Node labels: text-xs font-mono font-bold. Tooltips: text-xs.
Key Components: SVG bezier connection paths, interactive node pills, status indicator badges.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal panning viewport or simplified linear node list on mobile.
Accessibility: Provides accessible text table alternative for screen readers (`sr-only`).
Anti-Slop Rules: No chaotic spaghetti line connections; strictly orthogonal or smooth beziers.

Best For: Agencies that have real deliverables/screenshots to show for each step.
Layout Structure: Full-width alternating 2-column rows (Row 1: Image Left / Text Right; Row 2: Text Left / Image Right).
Typography Specs: Step H3: text-2xl font-bold. Step tag: text-xs font-mono text-primary.
Key Components: Step screenshot/illustration frame, deliverables pill cluster, step description.
Responsive Behavior: Always renders image first or text first consistently on mobile.
Accessibility: Images have contextual alt text explaining what deliverable is shown.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not use generic conceptual stock 3D graphics (e.g. floating puzzle pieces).

Best For: Creative studios, Awwwards-style agencies wanting immersive horizontal track exploration.
Layout Structure: Pinned container with CSS horizontal transform tracking scroll position; large step panels slide into view.
Typography Specs: Step titles: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold.
Key Components: Horizontal scroll track, progress bar indicator, step milestone panels.
Responsive Behavior: Reverts to standard vertical scroll on mobile to avoid scroll-trapping.
Accessibility: Respects prefers-reduced-motion; provides keyboard left/right arrow navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never lock user page scroll permanently; provide quick bypass button.

Best For: Processes with 6-8 steps where clients need to read thorough methodology paragraphs.
Layout Structure: Left sticky title and overview; Right stacked accordion rows that expand one at a time.
Typography Specs: Accordion trigger: text-lg font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed.
Key Components: Plus/minus or chevron icon with 180deg rotation, expanded content panel with deliverable tags.
Responsive Behavior: Left title stacks above accordion rows on mobile.
Accessibility: aria-expanded, aria-controls, keyboard Enter/Space expansion.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure smooth CSS height transition without content pop-in.

Best For: Ongoing retainer services (Audit -> Strategy -> Execute -> Analyze -> Repeat).
Layout Structure: Circular diagram with central core hub ('Continuous Growth') and 4-5 orbiting stage nodes with directional arrows.
Typography Specs: Hub text: text-sm font-bold font-mono. Orbiting node: text-sm font-semibold.
Key Components: Central anchor circle, radial dashed connector ring, step badges.
Responsive Behavior: Reorganizes into linear closed loop list with 'Repeat Cycle' banner on mobile.
Accessibility: Accessible linear fallback list declared in HTML.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep SVG math responsive; no clipped text nodes on small viewports.

Best For: Flagship marketing sites with custom UI previews or interactive graphics for each phase.
Layout Structure: 2-column container: Left column scrolls through text steps; Right column stays sticky (`sticky top-24`) and cross-fades matching graphic.
Typography Specs: Step title: text-3xl font-bold. Active indicator: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-primary.
Key Components: Sticky canvas container, intersection observer step triggers, cross-fading graphic layers.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into standard alternating cards on mobile viewports.
Accessibility: Screen reader reads uninterrupted sequential text without sticky distraction.
Anti-Slop Rules: No GPU-choking WebGL shaders; use lightweight CSS opacity transitions.

Best For: Agencies with high-production video or photo assets of their real team at work.
Layout Structure: Stacked full-width sections; each step has a dark atmospheric background photo with card overlay.
Typography Specs: Step numeral: text-5xl font-mono text-white/40. Headline: text-3xl font-bold text-white.
Key Components: High-res compressed background photos, dark gradient scrim, glassmorphic content card.
Responsive Behavior: Background photos set to object-cover with centered focal points.
Accessibility: High-contrast text overlay ensuring min 7:1 ratio over photo scrim.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure photos are heavily compressed (WebP/AVIF under 150kB).

Best For: Modern tech agencies mixing deliverables, tools, timeframes, and descriptions.
Layout Structure: 4-card or 5-card bento collage: Step 1 is wide hero block; Step 2-4 are compact modular blocks with tool icons.
Typography Specs: Card title: text-xl font-bold. Metadata tag: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Tool stack icons (Figma, Next.js), timeframe badge ('Days 1-3'), checklist items.
Responsive Behavior: Reflows into a single column on mobile.
Accessibility: Numbered step progression clearly indicated in heading text.
Anti-Slop Rules: No noisy gradient borders; clean dark slate surface with 1px border.

Best For: Design agencies with stunning, varied visual assets across web, mobile, and branding.
Layout Structure: 2 or 3-column masonry grid with staggered card heights and smooth hover zoom.
Typography Specs: Project title: text-xl font-bold. Category tag: text-xs font-mono uppercase.
Key Components: Rounded image frame, category badge, subtle hover scale (`scale-[1.02]`), case study link.
Responsive Behavior: Collapses to single column on mobile.
Accessibility: Descriptive alt text for all portfolio imagery; keyboard focus ring on card.
Anti-Slop Rules: No blurry thumbnail images; use crisp WebP assets.

Best For: Performance marketing, SEO, and CRO agencies where business outcomes matter most.
Layout Structure: Grid of 3 cards; the primary visual focal point of each card is a giant stat (e.g. '+340% MRR') placed above a clean UI preview.
Typography Specs: Stat: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold text-emerald-500. Title: text-lg font-bold.
Key Components: Giant metric badge, client logo, 3-sentence outcome summary, 'Read Case Study $\to$'.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 3 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Stats read cleanly by screen readers: 'Result: 340% increase in monthly recurring revenue'.
Anti-Slop Rules: All metrics must have context (e.g., 'Over 6 months'); avoid raw context-free numbers.

Best For: Agencies with 3 to 4 flagship enterprise transformation case studies.
Layout Structure: Stacked full-width rows alternating media left/text right, then media right/text left, with deliverable lists.
Typography Specs: Client H3: text-3xl font-bold. Deliverable pills: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Deliverable tags, client quote pull, challenge/solution bullets, full case study button.
Responsive Behavior: Always renders image first or text first consistently on mobile.
Accessibility: Strict semantic heading hierarchy; full keyboard focusable CTA.
Anti-Slop Rules: No stock mockups with generic lorem ipsum placeholders.

Best For: Full-service agencies with 12+ case studies across multiple disciplines (SEO, Branding, Dev).
Layout Structure: Top pill filter bar (All, E-Commerce, SaaS, B2B); clicking filters portfolio grid with smooth transition.
Typography Specs: Filter button: text-sm font-semibold. Project title: text-lg font-semibold.
Key Components: Active filter pill, animated grid reflow, count indicators per category ('SaaS (8)').
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scrolling filter pill bar on mobile.
Accessibility: aria-pressed on active filter button, live region announces number of filtered results.
Anti-Slop Rules: Filter animations must run in under 200ms; avoid slow layout repaints.

Best For: High-end studios showcasing 3 to 5 premier projects with tactile scroll feel.
Layout Structure: Vertical stack where each project card sticks to viewport top (`sticky top-20`) as the next card slides up and covers it.
Typography Specs: Title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-white.
Key Components: Stacked cards with increasing z-index and subtle top shadow, project metadata strip.
Responsive Behavior: Disables sticky overlay on mobile to maintain smooth scrolling.
Accessibility: Keyboard navigation moves cleanly through all cards in sequence.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure proper top offset (`top-20`, `top-24`) so cards don't overlap awkwardly.

Best For: Web design and development agencies emphasizing mobile-responsive excellence.
Layout Structure: Each project card features an overlapping desktop monitor + iPhone frame showing synchronized UI.
Typography Specs: Title: text-xl font-bold. Tags: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Monitor bezel + mobile bezel SVG frames, live website preview link, tech stack badges.
Responsive Behavior: Desktop monitor scales down; mobile frame stays sharp.
Accessibility: Alt text describes both desktop and mobile viewports.
Anti-Slop Rules: Device frames must be geometrically precise; no cheap skewed borders.

Best For: Consulting agencies and UX research studios that want to showcase analytical rigor.
Layout Structure: Project card divided into 3 equal horizontal segments: 1. The Challenge (Red tint), 2. The Strategy (Blue tint), 3. The Result (Green tint).
Typography Specs: Segment label: text-xs font-mono uppercase font-bold. Text: text-sm.
Key Components: 3-column segment card, verified client badge, outcome metric.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into 3 vertical micro-blocks on mobile.
Accessibility: Clear screen reader landmarking for each of the 3 stages.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep text concise (max 2 sentences per segment).

Archetype Name: Minimalist Text List with Image Hover
Best For: Avant-garde design studios, editorial practices with prestigious client names.
Layout Structure: Clean horizontal typography rows (Year, Client Name, Service, Award Badge); hovering row shows floating project thumbnail.
Typography Specs: Client Name: text-2xl sm:text-4xl font-light hover:italic transition-all.
Key Components: Floating pointer-following image preview, award badge (`Site of the Day`), arrow icon.
Responsive Behavior: Thumbnail renders inline beneath text on mobile viewports.
Accessibility: Standard HTML table or list markup with full keyboard accessibility.
Anti-Slop Rules: Image hover must follow cursor smoothly without jitter.

Best For: Agencies with 10+ glowing client reviews of varied lengths.
Layout Structure: 3-column masonry card grid (`columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6`).
Typography Specs: Quote: text-sm leading-relaxed. Client Name: text-sm font-semibold. Title: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Avatar image (40x40 rounded-full), 5-star SVG cluster, client role & company logo, verified review badge.
Responsive Behavior: Single column on mobile, 2 columns on tablet, 3 columns on desktop.
Accessibility: Each review wrapped in <blockquote> and <figure> with <figcaption>.
Anti-Slop Rules: All reviewer photos must be real clients with verifiable LinkedIn/Twitter links.

Best For: Agencies with 1 or 2 mega-prestige enterprise quotes (e.g., from a VP at a Fortune 500).
Layout Structure: Centered or split layout with an oversized 32px serif quotation mark, giant 28px quote text, client headshot and company logo.
Typography Specs: Quote: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)].
Key Components: Oversized decorative quote mark, client company SVG logo, high-res executive headshot.
Responsive Behavior: Scales font down gracefully on mobile screens.
Accessibility: Semantic blockquote with cite attribute.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake generic praise ('They did great work!'); must cite specific business impact.

Best For: High-ticket agencies ($10k-$100k+) where video interviews convert skeptics.
Layout Structure: Grid of 2 or 3 video cards with play button overlay, video runtime badge ('1:45 min'), and summary bullet beneath.
Typography Specs: Headline quote: text-base font-semibold. Runtime badge: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Video thumbnail with play icon, modal video player, client credentials badge.
Responsive Behavior: Cards stack into single column on mobile.
Accessibility: Play button has aria-label='Watch video review from [Name]'; captions provided.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not autoplay all videos; user must explicitly click to play.

Archetype Name: Verifiable Twitter / LinkedIn Social Embed Cards
Best For: Tech agencies, developer tools, and modern growth agencies whose clients tweet praise organically.
Layout Structure: Grid of cards styled exactly like native Twitter/LinkedIn posts with verification checks and timestamps.
Typography Specs: Body: text-sm. Handle: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Social platform icon (X or LinkedIn), verified checkmark icon, clickable link to original post.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2-3 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Card contains link to external post with aria-label='View original post on Twitter'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not fabricate fake social posts; links must point to live public tweets.

Archetype Name: Split Testimonial with Verified Revenue Graph
Best For: B2B performance agencies backing client quotes with empirical revenue analytics.
Layout Structure: 2-column card: Left column client quote & credentials; Right column verified revenue chart from Stripe/Google Analytics.
Typography Specs: Metric callout: text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-500. Quote: text-base font-medium.
Key Components: Verified data tag ('Stripe Verified Revenue'), SVG area graph, client quote.
Responsive Behavior: Quote on top, chart below on mobile.
Accessibility: Chart data summarized in accessible text description for screen readers.
Anti-Slop Rules: Graph axes must be clearly labeled; no meaningless upward squiggles.

Best For: Boutique agencies and consultants where hearing real client enthusiasm builds massive rapport.
Layout Structure: Card featuring client avatar, quote snippet, and an interactive audio waveform player with play/pause and progress bar.
Typography Specs: Client Name: text-sm font-semibold. Duration: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: SVG audio waveform bars, play/pause toggle button, scrubber timeline.
Responsive Behavior: Full width card on mobile.
Accessibility: Full written text transcript provided right beneath the audio player.
Anti-Slop Rules: Audio must be user-triggered; never autoplay.

Best For: Consumer tech, high-volume B2B with 20+ short one-line reviews.
Layout Structure: Two horizontal rows of testimonial cards: Row 1 scrolls smoothly left-to-right; Row 2 scrolls right-to-left.
Typography Specs: Card quote: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Compact review cards, subtle border, star rating, CSS marquee track with pause-on-hover.
Responsive Behavior: Maintains continuous marquee on mobile with touch drag support.
Accessibility: Pause button provided, respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Anti-Slop Rules: Speed must be comfortable to read (35-45s per cycle); not hyper-fast.

Archetype Name: Compact Star Rating Strip with Featured Avatar Stack
Best For: Single-page landing pages, minimal sites that don't want a heavy review section.
Layout Structure: A single compact horizontal banner: Overlapping avatar cluster left + 'Rated 4.9/5 by 340+ clients' center + Trustpilot/Google badge right.
Typography Specs: Rating text: text-sm font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)].
Key Components: Avatar stack, 5 gold star icons, external review platform badge (Clutch/Google).
Responsive Behavior: Flex items wrap gracefully on small screens.
Accessibility: Accessible rating description: 'Average rating 4.9 out of 5 based on 340 reviews'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake star ratings without platform link.

Best For: Standard agencies wanting clean high-impact numerical proof: clients served, revenue generated, years active, success rate.
Layout Structure: Full-width centered row of 3-4 stat blocks separated by subtle vertical dividers; each: giant counter numeral plus suffix plus descriptor label.
Typography Specs: Counter: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold text-[var(--color-primary)]. Label: text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-widest.
Key Components: Intersection Observer scroll-trigger, count-up animation via requestAnimationFrame, verified data footnote.
Responsive Behavior: 2x2 grid on mobile, horizontal row on desktop with consistent spacing.
Accessibility: aria-label on each stat cell stating the full fact. Animation pauses if prefers-reduced-motion.
Anti-Slop Rules: Every stat must be specific and defensible; no unqualified round numbers. Add month/year qualifier.

Best For: CRO, redesign, and performance agencies with dramatic before/after visual or metric proof.
Layout Structure: 2-panel draggable comparison slider: left panel (muted grey tinted, Before badge), right panel (vibrant primary tinted, After badge) with draggable center divider.
Typography Specs: Panel badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase. Metric callout: text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-500.
Key Components: Draggable divider handle, metric overlay badges per panel, context caption beneath.
Responsive Behavior: Touch-draggable on mobile with snap zones at 20%, 50%, 80%.
Accessibility: input type=range controlling panel split position; keyboard left/right arrows adjust; aria-valuetext announces split percentage.
Anti-Slop Rules: Before state must be visually distinct; do not exaggerate cosmetic differences.

Best For: Performance and growth agencies with real analytics screenshots and verifiable growth trajectories.
Layout Structure: 3-column card grid; each card: client name and metric label at top, inline SVG area chart in middle, verified source badge and outcome stat at bottom.
Typography Specs: Metric: text-4xl font-extrabold text-emerald-500. Source badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold.
Key Components: Inline SVG area charts, Stripe Verified or GA4 Verified badges, client attribution.
Responsive Behavior: Cards stack into single column on mobile. Charts remain readable at reduced width.
Accessibility: Each chart has accessible text summary. Chart SVG marked aria-hidden with text alternative.
Anti-Slop Rules: Charts must have labeled axes and date ranges; no unlabeled upward squiggles.

Best For: Established agencies (5+ years) celebrating key inflection points in their growth journey.
Layout Structure: Horizontal scrolling timeline (desktop) with year nodes and milestone cards; vertical left-spine timeline on mobile.
Typography Specs: Year: text-2xl font-mono font-bold. Milestone title: text-base font-semibold. Detail: text-sm.
Key Components: Year nodes with connecting spine, milestone cards for founding and expansion and awards, photo thumbnails.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scroll with snap-mandatory on desktop; vertical spine on mobile.
Accessibility: Wrapped in ordered list preserving chronological DOM sequence.
Anti-Slop Rules: Limit to 5-7 genuinely significant milestones; do not list every minor blog post.

Best For: High-volume growth agencies or e-commerce specialists wanting to demonstrate live scale.
Layout Structure: Full-width dark banner with animated rolling counter showing live revenue metric, green pulse dot, and live timestamp.
Typography Specs: Counter: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-mono font-extrabold text-emerald-400. Label: text-xs font-mono uppercase.
Key Components: Rolling number counter, green status pulse dot, live-updated timestamp, Last updated label.
Responsive Behavior: Scales font down on mobile; counter remains readable.
Accessibility: aria-live=off on counter to prevent screen reader announcing every digit change; summary read on page load.
Anti-Slop Rules: Only use live ticker if you can feed it real data; a static fake counter destroys trust when scrutinized.

Archetype Name: Stat Plus Signed Quote Proof Cards
Best For: Enterprise agencies where each result needs direct attribution to a named executive for maximum credibility.
Layout Structure: 3-column grid of cards; each: giant metric plus signed client quote beneath with executive name, title, company logo.
Typography Specs: Metric: text-4xl font-extrabold. Quote: text-sm font-medium italic. Attribution: text-xs font-semibold.
Key Components: Bold metric badge, italic quote blockquote, executive avatar 40px plus name plus title plus company SVG logo.
Responsive Behavior: Cards stack into single column on mobile with consistent padding.
Accessibility: Quote wrapped in semantic blockquote with cite element.
Anti-Slop Rules: Quotes must be real attributed statements; no anonymous satisfied client attribution.

Best For: Agencies with standardized service tiers or retainer packages.
Layout Structure: 3-column grid (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8`); center card elevated with primary border, 'Most Popular' chip, and prominent CTA.
Typography Specs: Price: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-extrabold. Tier name: text-lg font-bold. Period: text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Pill badge ('Most Popular'), price numeral, feature checkmark list, primary/secondary CTA button.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into 3 cards on mobile with the highlighted tier shown first or labeled clearly.
Accessibility: Clear H3 per tier, feature lists use <ul> and accessible icons.
Anti-Slop Rules: No hidden fee disclaimers in 8px unreadable micro-text.

Best For: Recurring retainers, software subscriptions, productized agencies with discount incentives.
Layout Structure: Centered toggle pill button ('Monthly' / 'Annual — Save 20%') above 3 pricing cards; prices smoothly update via state.
Typography Specs: Toggle: text-sm font-semibold. Discount badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-500.
Key Components: Accessible switch toggle, discount pill badge, animated price transition.
Responsive Behavior: Cards stack vertically on mobile; toggle stays sticky or centered.
Accessibility: role='switch', aria-checked, keyboard spacebar triggers toggle.
Anti-Slop Rules: Show exact dollar savings, not misleading percentage math.

Best For: Custom agencies where pricing scales with pages, ad spend, or team seats.
Layout Structure: Interactive slider panel on left (e.g., 'Estimated Monthly Ad Spend: $10,000'); Right card calculates recommended retainer and deliverables in real time.
Typography Specs: Calculated total: text-4xl font-extrabold text-primary. Slider label: text-sm font-semibold.
Key Components: Accessible range input sliders, dynamic price ticker, instant 'Book Scope Call' CTA.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column vertical stack on mobile.
Accessibility: input type='range' with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow.
Anti-Slop Rules: Always include a baseline floor price to avoid unrealistic low estimates.

Best For: Productized subscription agencies offering one all-inclusive flagship tier.
Layout Structure: Single large prominent card (max-w-2xl mx-auto) with bold flat monthly fee, 'Pause or cancel anytime' guarantee, and 2-column checklist of all inclusions.
Typography Specs: Price: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black. Inclusions: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: 'Pause or cancel anytime' tag, lightning turnaround guarantee, comprehensive deliverable list.
Responsive Behavior: Inclusions list collapses to single column on mobile.
Accessibility: Clear single tab stop for CTA button, fully semantic list.
Anti-Slop Rules: No asterisks or fine print hiding cancellation lock-ins.

Best For: Enterprise tools and large agencies with 20+ granular feature distinctions between tiers.
Layout Structure: Top tier summary cards + comprehensive comparison table below with sticky table header on scroll.
Typography Specs: Feature name: text-sm. Category header: text-xs font-mono uppercase font-bold.
Key Components: Green checkmark icons, grey minus icons, tooltip definitions for complex features.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal overflow scroll container on mobile with sticky left feature column.
Accessibility: Table has proper scope attributes (<th scope='col'> and <th scope='row'>).
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep checkmark colors accessible; do not use faint unreadable greens.

Best For: High-end bespoke agencies and enterprise consultants who do not publish fixed rates.
Layout Structure: 3 value bracket cards ('Bespoke Sprint', 'Dedicated Pod', 'Enterprise Retainer') with starting budgets (e.g. 'From $25k') and 'Request Custom Proposal' CTA.
Typography Specs: Bracket title: text-xl font-bold. Starting at text: text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Scope description, typical duration pill ('8-12 weeks'), proposal booking button.
Responsive Behavior: Cards stack into 3 neat rows on mobile.
Accessibility: Distinct button labels specifying which bracket proposal is being requested.
Anti-Slop Rules: Always state a realistic baseline ('Projects typically start at $20k') to filter unqualified leads.

Keywords: team-grid, cards, headshots, bio, role, standard
Best For: Agencies with 3-12 team members wanting a clean, professional team introduction.
Layout Structure: Responsive card grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Each card: portrait photo (aspect-square rounded-2xl object-cover), name, role badge, 2-line bio, LinkedIn icon link.
Typography Specs: Name: text-lg font-semibold. Role: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider. Bio: text-sm.
Key Components: Portrait photo (high-res, consistent aspect-square crop), role chip, 2-line bio, LinkedIn icon link.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3-4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Portrait alt text includes Name, Role and Agency name. LinkedIn link has aria-label.
Anti-Slop Rules: No mismatched aspect ratios across team photos; enforce consistent cropping. No AI-generated headshots.

Best For: Boutique agencies where the 1-2 founders are the primary trust signal and supporting staff are secondary.
Layout Structure: Top tier: 1 or 2 large founder cards (wider aspect ratio, expanded bio paragraph, awards listed). Bottom tier: compact grid of 4-6 supporting team member cards.
Typography Specs: Founder name: text-2xl font-bold. Founder bio: text-base. Supporting name: text-base font-semibold.
Key Components: Large founder portrait (aspect-video or 3:4), credentials pill strip, expanded bio paragraph, compact team grid below.
Responsive Behavior: Founder cards stack above supporting team grid on mobile.
Accessibility: Clear H2 for Leadership section and H3 for Team subsection.
Anti-Slop Rules: Founder bio must be specific with years experience, past companies, notable wins; no generic visionary leader copy.

Best For: Creative agencies wanting to show team personality and culture, not just corporate credentials.
Layout Structure: Grid of team cards; default: professional portrait plus name plus role. Hover: card flips or slides to reveal fun fact, favorite tool, and social links.
Typography Specs: Role: text-xs font-mono. Fun fact: text-sm italic font-medium. Tool badge: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Card flip animation via CSS transform rotateY or slide-reveal, fun fact, tool icon badge, social media links.
Responsive Behavior: On touch devices, tap toggles card state. Touch-active state indicated by bottom indicator dot.
Accessibility: Flip accessible via keyboard focus (Enter toggles). Both front and back content readable by screen reader with aria-hidden on inactive face.
Anti-Slop Rules: Fun facts must be genuine and unique per person; no generic loves coffee and coding placeholder copy.

Best For: Larger agencies (15-50 people) with distinct departments: Strategy, Creative, Engineering, Client Success.
Layout Structure: Top horizontal department tab bar; clicking a tab filters the team grid to show only that department with animated transition.
Typography Specs: Department tab: text-sm font-semibold. Member count badge: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Tab pill navigation with member count badges, animated grid reflow, All default tab.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scrolling tab strip on mobile.
Accessibility: role=tablist, role=tab, aria-selected, keyboard left/right navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not create a miscellaneous or other department tab; every person belongs to a named team.

Keywords: editorial, masonry, portrait, luxury, artistic, photography-first
Best For: High-end creative studios and luxury brands with editorial-quality professional photography.
Layout Structure: Asymmetric masonry layout with varied portrait card heights and minimal overlaid text; hovering reveals name and role in a bottom gradient scrim.
Typography Specs: Overlay name: text-xl font-semibold text-white. Overlay role: text-xs font-mono text-white/70.
Key Components: High-res editorial portraits, bottom gradient scrim overlay, hover reveal name/role, subtle image scale on hover.
Responsive Behavior: Single column of portraits on mobile with static name/role visible beneath each.
Accessibility: Portrait alt text includes name and role. Hover-revealed text also present in DOM (visually hidden on non-hover).
Anti-Slop Rules: Zero stock photography; all photos must be real team members shot with editorial lighting.

Archetype Name: Compact Name and Role List (Remote Distributed)
Best For: Fully remote or large distributed teams where showing 30+ faces is impractical but acknowledging scale matters.
Layout Structure: 2-column text list; each entry: name (font-semibold), role (font-mono text-muted), timezone/location tag. Header stats: total team size, countries represented.
Typography Specs: Name: text-sm font-semibold. Role: text-xs font-mono. Location tag: text-xs.
Key Components: Team size stat badge at section top, compact name/role rows, timezone flag as location indicator.
Responsive Behavior: Single column list on mobile.
Accessibility: List uses semantic ul and li. Location flags have aria-label with country name.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not use country flag emojis as the primary location indicator; also include the country name in text.

Best For: Standard agencies with 5 to 8 common client questions.
Layout Structure: Centered container (max-w-3xl mx-auto) with stacked accordion rows separated by subtle 1px borders.
Typography Specs: Question trigger: text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Answer: text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Expanding container, plus/minus or rotating chevron icon, smooth height transition.
Responsive Behavior: Full width with 16px horizontal screen padding on mobile.
Accessibility: <button aria-expanded='false' aria-controls='faq-answer-1'>, keyboard Enter/Space toggles.
Anti-Slop Rules: No sudden jarring height jumps; use CSS grid 0fr -> 1fr transition.

Best For: Agencies with 12+ questions across multiple categories (General, Pricing, Process, Technical).
Layout Structure: Left sticky column with category navigation pills; Right column displays matching accordion questions.
Typography Specs: Category tab: text-sm font-semibold. Question: text-base font-semibold.
Key Components: Sticky category sidebar, active category indicator pill, accordion list.
Responsive Behavior: Category tabs convert to horizontal scrollable strip on mobile.
Accessibility: role='tablist' for categories; aria-selected states managed properly.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not duplicate identical questions across multiple categories.

Best For: Agencies with 4 to 6 short, punchy questions where answers are immediately visible without clicking.
Layout Structure: 2-column grid (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6`); each card contains the question as an H3 and the answer directly below.
Typography Specs: Question: text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Answer: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Bordered surface cards, subtle icon accent, zero hidden text.
Responsive Behavior: Single column vertical stack on mobile.
Accessibility: Direct text in DOM, zero aria-expanded state overhead.
Anti-Slop Rules: Answers must be under 3 sentences; long essays belong in an accordion.

Archetype Name: Searchable FAQ with Live Instant Filter
Best For: Technical agencies, platforms, and products with 15+ detailed questions.
Layout Structure: Prominent search input bar on top with search icon and clear button; questions filter in real time as user types.
Typography Specs: Search placeholder: text-base. Match count: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Search input, real-time regex/BM25 filter, 'No matching questions found' fallback state with contact button.
Responsive Behavior: Input fills 100% width on mobile.
Accessibility: aria-live='polite' announces number of matching questions.
Anti-Slop Rules: Filter response must be instantaneous (<16ms, zero debounce lag).

Archetype Name: Split Layout (Contact Card Left / FAQ Right)
Best For: Agencies focused on lead generation where the FAQ directly funnels into a consultation.
Layout Structure: Left column has H2, intro copy, and a sticky 'Still have questions? Chat with our team' card; Right column has accordion questions.
Typography Specs: Left title: text-3xl font-bold. Chat card: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Support team avatar stack, live response time badge, direct WhatsApp / Calendar button.
Responsive Behavior: Left contact prompt stacks beneath the accordion on mobile.
Accessibility: Clear focus sequence from questions to the contact card.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not hide the contact button behind an accordion.

Best For: Ultra-minimalist landing pages that want to keep page length short.
Layout Structure: A single compact section row: 'Have questions before getting started? [Open FAQ $\to$]'; clicking slides open a right-side drawer containing the full FAQ.
Typography Specs: Prompt text: text-lg font-semibold. Drawer title: text-2xl font-bold.
Key Components: Drawer trigger button, accessible slide-over sheet component (`BottomSheet` / `ModalDialog`).
Responsive Behavior: Drawer opens fullscreen on mobile devices.
Accessibility: Focus trapped inside sheet, Escape key dismisses, aria-modal='true'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure drawer backdrop is dark enough (50% scrim) to maintain text focus.

Best For: General agencies and SaaS landing pages with a clear primary conversion goal.
Layout Structure: Centered rounded card (`rounded-3xl p-12 sm:p-16`) with high-contrast background (dark on light site, or primary gradient on dark site), bold H2, subtitle, and dual CTA buttons.
Typography Specs: H2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight. Subhead: text-lg text-slate-300.
Key Components: High-contrast container, primary action button, secondary ghost button, confidence guarantee tag ('No credit card required').
Responsive Behavior: Paddings reduce to p-8 on mobile; buttons stack full width.
Accessibility: Ensures min 7:1 contrast ratio between text and card background.
Anti-Slop Rules: No purple radioactive gradient glows; use deep grounded slate or accessible navy.

Best For: Agencies where booking a 30-minute discovery call is the sole metric of success.
Layout Structure: Left column explains what happens on the call (Agenda, Who you will meet, Deliverables); Right column embeds an inline Cal.com / Calendly booking widget.
Typography Specs: Agenda items: text-sm font-semibold. Call duration badge: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Agenda bullet list, host avatar & bio, responsive iframe/widget container with loading state.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with booking widget on bottom.
Accessibility: Iframe has descriptive title='Book a discovery call on Cal.com'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not embed broken widgets without a direct link fallback.

Best For: SEO, PPC, and CRO agencies offering a free automated audit or quote.
Layout Structure: Centered banner with bold headline ('Get your free 14-point audit in 24 hours') + clean 2-field form (Website URL + Email) with submit CTA.
Typography Specs: Input text: text-base. Button text: text-base font-bold.
Key Components: Form fields with floating labels, honeypot spam protection, submission status spinner.
Responsive Behavior: Inline desktop layout; stacked inputs and button on mobile.
Accessibility: Visible labels, aria-live status announcement on submit.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never ask for phone numbers or company size in a final instant capture form.

Archetype Name: Interactive Contact Form with Budget Pills
Best For: High-ticket agencies that need to qualify client budgets before accepting calls.
Layout Structure: Clean card with multi-choice budget pills ('$5k-$10k', '$10k-$25k', '$25k+') + service checkboxes + message field.
Typography Specs: Pill text: text-xs font-mono font-semibold. Section labels: text-sm font-bold.
Key Components: Custom toggle pills (`role='radio'`), accessible text inputs, privacy reassurance tag.
Responsive Behavior: Budget pills wrap neatly in 2 columns on mobile.
Accessibility: role='radiogroup' for budget selection; keyboard arrow navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep form steps under 4 questions to prevent abandonment.

Best For: Elite boutique studios and high-trust consultants pitching senior executives.
Layout Structure: Personal invitation card: Founder headshot, direct phone number, personal direct email, and promise: 'I reply to every email personally within 4 hours'.
Typography Specs: Letter text: text-lg font-serif leading-relaxed. Founder name: text-base font-bold.
Key Components: Authentic candid portrait, direct mailto/tel links, copyable email button.
Responsive Behavior: Centered stack on mobile viewports.
Accessibility: Clear tel and mailto links with aria-labels.
Anti-Slop Rules: No generic contact@ or info@ addresses; use real person's email.

Best For: Agencies or SaaS catering to two completely different customer tiers.
Layout Structure: Side-by-side 2-column card: Left side 'For Early-Stage Startups' (Self-serve / Fast kickoff); Right side 'For Enterprise Teams' (Custom security / Talk to VP).
Typography Specs: Path title: text-2xl font-bold. Description: text-sm.
Key Components: Two distinct CTA buttons with specific routing, separate feature bullet points.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into two distinct sequential cards on mobile.
Accessibility: Distinct heading levels (H3) and clear button labels for each path.
Anti-Slop Rules: Make visual weight equal or intentionally elevate the higher-value path.

Best For: Standard agencies with rich sitemaps, services, resources, and legal pages.
Layout Structure: 4 or 5-column grid: Column 1 brand logo & mission summary; Columns 2-4 category link columns; Column 5 newsletter / social links.
Typography Specs: Column headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Links: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-white.
Key Components: Brand logo, social icon strip (SVG), category columns, bottom copyright and legal bar (Privacy, Terms, Cookies).
Responsive Behavior: Collapses to 2-column on tablet, single accordion or stacked list on mobile.
Accessibility: role='contentinfo', link lists wrapped in <ul>, valid focus states.
Anti-Slop Rules: No broken placeholder links; all links must resolve.

Best For: Awwwards-style creative design studios and luxury brands.
Layout Structure: Top tier simple link row; Bottom tier dominated by a massive full-width agency name in 12vw typography stretching across the viewport.
Typography Specs: Giant wordmark: text-[12vw] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none text-[var(--border-subtle)].
Key Components: Massive SVG or font wordmark, time zone clocks ('London 14:32 • New York 09:32'), minimal legal row.
Responsive Behavior: Viewport-width typography (`12vw`) scales smoothly without horizontal overflow.
Accessibility: Giant wordmark marked aria-hidden='true' if redundant to brand text.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure overflow-hidden on container to prevent horizontal scrollbar bugs.

Best For: Agencies with active thought leadership, research reports, or newsletters.
Layout Structure: Top prominent newsletter card ('Join 15,000 marketing leaders receiving our weekly teardown') with inline email form + standard link grid below.
Typography Specs: Newsletter title: text-xl font-bold. Form button: text-sm font-semibold.
Key Components: Email input field, subscribe button, anti-spam reassurance, subscriber count badge.
Responsive Behavior: Newsletter input stacks above button on mobile.
Accessibility: Explicit label for email input, aria-live error/success message.
Anti-Slop Rules: No annoying pop-ups; keep the newsletter anchored gracefully in the footer.

Best For: Single-page landing pages, personal portfolios, minimal micro-sites.
Layout Structure: A single clean horizontal row (`h-16 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] px-6 flex items-center justify-between`): Logo left, Copyright center, Social links right.
Typography Specs: Text: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]. Social icons: 18x18 SVG.
Key Components: Logo mark, copyright text, minimal social icon links.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into centered vertical column on mobile with 8px spacing.
Accessibility: Full keyboard accessibility on all social icon links with aria-labels.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not omit mandatory legal links (Privacy Policy) if collecting data.

Best For: International agencies with offices across multiple cities (e.g. New York, London, Tokyo).
Layout Structure: Grid of office location cards; each card features city name, local live time clock, physical address, and local phone number.
Typography Specs: City name: text-lg font-bold. Time clock: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-500.
Key Components: Live JavaScript time clock per city, Google Maps link, local phone number.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Live clocks update without triggering disruptive screen reader announcements.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure phone numbers use international dial codes (+1, +44).

Best For: Agencies with proprietary software, mobile apps, or extensive partner integrations.
Layout Structure: Top tier App Store & Google Play badge buttons + QR code for instant phone scan; Bottom tier standard legal and platform status link.
Typography Specs: Badge subtext: text-[10px]. Badge title: text-xs font-bold.
Key Components: App Store SVG badge, Google Play SVG badge, QR code frame with scan tooltip, system status badge ('All systems normal').
Responsive Behavior: QR code hides on mobile viewports; direct app store buttons take full width.
Accessibility: Badges have descriptive aria-labels ('Download on Apple App Store').
Anti-Slop Rules: Use official brand SVG assets for store badges; no distorted PNGs.

Archetype Name: Centered Toggle Hero with Trial Chip
Best For: SaaS products offering self-serve monthly and annual plans with a discount incentive.
Layout Structure: Centered max-w-4xl mx-auto py-20 text-center flex flex-col items-center. Category eyebrow chip, punchy H1, subtitle, followed by an accessible segmented control pill toggle (Monthly / Annual [Save 20%]).
Typography Specs: H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight. Pill text: text-sm font-semibold. Discount badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full.
Key Components: Category chip, massive H1, subhead, segmented pill button toggle with active sliding indicator, 14-day trial badge.
Responsive Behavior: Stays centered; pill toggle remains full-width or auto-centered with 44px min tap target.
Accessibility: Segmented switch uses role='radiogroup' or aria-pressed='true' on the selected billing interval.
Anti-Slop Rules: No shouting fake urgency timers ('Offer ends in 3 mins!'); keep discount pill tasteful and quiet.

Archetype Name: Split Value-Proof Hero with ROI Calculator Trigger
Best For: B2B and enterprise solutions where price requires immediate ROI justification and payback-period evidence.
Layout Structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center py-20). Left (7 cols): High-impact value proposition, guaranteed ROI statement. Right (5 cols): Compact interactive payback estimator widget.
Typography Specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight. Metric callouts: text-3xl font-mono font-extrabold text-[var(--primary)].
Key Components: Value headline, 3-bullet ROI guarantee list, interactive slider widget estimating monthly hours/dollars saved.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline on top and calculator card below.
Accessibility: Slider input has aria-label='Team size slider' with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow.
Anti-Slop Rules: ROI estimates must state standard methodology assumptions; no arbitrary 10,000% claims.

Best For: Developer infrastructure, API platforms, and usage-based products where pricing scales with volume or seats.
Layout Structure: Single column max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center py-16. Interactive logarithmic scale slider directly under the headline dynamically updating tier recommendation in real time.
Typography Specs: Slider readout: text-4xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Sub-label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Logarithmic range input, current value badge, recommended tier indicator, dynamic price preview.
Responsive Behavior: Full width slider track with oversized 28px draggable thumb for touch friendliness.
Accessibility: Keyboard arrow keys increment/decrement slider; aria-valuetext announces estimated tier.
Anti-Slop Rules: No jumping layout heights during value scrub; fixed dimension value container.

Best For: Products with 20+ features categorized across Core, Security, Integrations, and Support tiers.
Layout Structure: Full-width table with sticky top row containing plan names and mini-CTAs on window scroll. Rows grouped by category headers (collapsible). Cells display checkmarks, dashes, or specific numeric limits.
Typography Specs: Category headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Feature names: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]. Tier headers: text-base font-bold.
