Key Components: Sticky thead, info tooltip triggers on technical terms, category accordion headers, SVG check / minus icons, plan CTA buttons.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal swipe container on mobile with sticky first column (feature name) and scroll indicators.
Accessibility: th scope='col' on plan names, th scope='row' on feature names, tooltips accessible via keyboard focus and Esc to close.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not use low-contrast grey checks against light backgrounds; use high-contrast primary or emerald checkmarks.

Best For: SaaS platforms wanting to prevent 100-row endless scroll fatigue by partitioning features into switchable tabs.
Layout Structure: Centered max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16. Top tab bar ('Platform Core', 'Security & Compliance', 'Analytics', 'APIs & Developer'). Selecting a tab swaps the active 8-12 row comparison table with zero page jump.
Typography Specs: Tab labels: text-sm font-semibold. Table headers: text-base font-bold. Row cells: text-sm.
Key Components: Segmented tab control, animated tab indicator, clean 4-column matrix, feature description tooltips.
Responsive Behavior: Tabs convert to horizontal scroll list on mobile with snap-x scrolling.
Accessibility: role='tablist' with role='tab' and aria-selected state; keyboard ArrowLeft / ArrowRight navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Tab transitions must use opacity only (duration-150); never use bouncy layout-shifting animations.

Best For: High-velocity sales where prospects just want to know 'what do I get if I pay for Pro instead of Starter?'
Layout Structure: Compact table showing only the 8-10 features that differ between tiers, with a toggle button: 'Show all 45 features'.
Typography Specs: Header: text-lg font-bold. Delta rows: text-sm font-medium. Toggle button: text-xs font-mono underline.
Key Components: 'Show differences only' switch, clean delta rows, expandable drawer for complete baseline specs.
Responsive Behavior: Clean 3-column card comparison on mobile without horizontal scrolling.
Accessibility: Expand button has aria-expanded='false' and aria-controls='full-feature-table'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Clearly state that baseline features are included in higher tiers so users are not confused.

Best For: Products with specialized upgrades (Dedicated IP, Custom Onboarding, SOC2 Report, Extra Storage).
Layout Structure: 2-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto py-12). Each card features checkbox/switch, addon title, description, and '+ $X/mo' badge.
Typography Specs: Addon title: text-base font-semibold. Price tag: text-sm font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Description: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Custom accessible checkbox, price badge, title, 2-line explanation, optional tooltip.
Responsive Behavior: Single column stack on mobile with full-width tap target cards.
Accessibility: role='checkbox' with aria-checked, keyboard Space to toggle, card click delegates to input.
Anti-Slop Rules: No pre-checking optional add-ons as sneaky dark patterns; all add-ons default to unchecked.

Archetype Name: Horizontal Add-on Strip with Live Cart Subtotal
Best For: E-commerce or developer API tools with quick one-click provision extras.
Layout Structure: Stacked horizontal strip rows separated by 1px borders. Left: Icon + title. Center: pricing metric. Right: '+ Add' button that changes to checked state.
Typography Specs: Title: text-sm font-medium. Price: text-sm font-mono. Button: text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5.
Key Components: Icon, descriptor, unit price, actionable stateful toggle button, bottom sticky subtotal readout.
Responsive Behavior: Wraps price and button cleanly on mobile without line truncation.
Accessibility: Buttons have clear aria-label='Add Dedicated Support to subscription for $150 per month'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Explicit price per billing cycle; never hide whether addon is monthly or annual.

Best For: Enterprise procurement teams requiring SOC2, HIPAA, custom MSAs, 99.99% uptime, and vendor diligence.
Layout Structure: Full-width elevated card (max-w-6xl mx-auto py-12 px-8 sm:px-12 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]). Left 2/3: Enterprise capability matrix (SAML SSO, SCIM, Dedicated CSM, Custom Legal MSA). Right 1/3: 'Contact Enterprise Sales' primary action card with guaranteed response time.
Typography Specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold. Checklist: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Security certification badges (SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001, GDPR), 4-item compliance checklist, 'Talk to Enterprise Sales' CTA button, response time guarantee chip ('< 2 hr response').
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into single column on mobile with CTA pinned below the checklist.
Accessibility: Semantic list <ul> with SVG checkmarks having aria-hidden='true', CTA button has descriptive focus ring.
Anti-Slop Rules: No generic 'Enterprise-grade' marketing buzzwords without citing actual verified protocols (e.g. specify SAML 2.0 / Okta / Azure AD).

Best For: Companies with high contract values ($20k+/yr) where instant quoting is replaced with custom scoping.
Layout Structure: 2-column container. Left: Executive trust bullets and customer logos. Right: 4-field enterprise qualification form (Work email, Company size, Deployment timeline, Primary requirement).
Typography Specs: Form labels: text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Form inputs: text-sm py-2.5 px-3.5.
Key Components: Work email validator, company size dropdown, timeline selector, single submit button with loading state.
Responsive Behavior: Full width form fields on mobile; labels remain top-aligned.
Accessibility: Inputs paired with explicit <label for='...'> tags, aria-required='true', aria-invalid error state messaging.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never ask for phone numbers on step 1 unless strictly necessary; keep form friction low (max 4 fields).

Best For: Overcoming final purchase anxiety before checkout across both consumer and B2B SaaS.
Layout Structure: Full-width subtle container py-8 border-y border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--surface-subtle)]. 3-column layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 text-center).
Typography Specs: Badge title: text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Sub-text: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Shield SVG icon (30-day money-back guarantee), Lock SVG icon (256-bit SSL encrypted checkout), Refresh SVG icon (Cancel or downgrade anytime with 1 click).
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into 3 centered items on mobile with 16px vertical gap.
Accessibility: Semantic section with aria-label='Security and Guarantee Commitments'.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake green padlock clipart or unverified security badges; clean monochromatic outline SVG icons only.

Best For: Mobile optimization for complex pricing pages where user scrolls far past the pricing cards.
Layout Structure: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (sm:hidden) z-40 bg-[var(--surface)]/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xl.
Typography Specs: Selected plan: text-xs font-semibold. Price: text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Button: text-sm font-semibold.
Key Components: Plan name summary, price/billing interval text, compact 'Choose Plan' CTA button.
Responsive Behavior: Hidden on desktop (sm:hidden), visible and fixed to viewport bottom on mobile.
Accessibility: Doesn't block content navigation; dismissible or scrolls quietly into view after passing tier section.
Anti-Slop Rules: Do not cover more than 68px of screen height; respect bottom safe-area-inset.

Keywords: timeline, milestones, company-history, journey, origin-story, vertical-timeline
Best For: Established companies or agencies with 4-8 chronological milestones (Founding, Seed, Series A, Global Expansion).
Layout Structure: Central vertical spine (1px subtle border) with alternating cards on left and right (desktop). Each node features a glowing year pill, milestone headline, 2-line description, and metric badge.
Typography Specs: Year badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)] bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full. Milestone title: text-lg font-bold. Body: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Vertical SVG connecting line, milestone node dots, year badge, event title, optional press/metric tag.
Responsive Behavior: Collapses to single-sided timeline on mobile: vertical line aligns to left margin (pl-8), all cards align right.
Accessibility: Semantic ordered list <ol>, each milestone is an <li> with an aria-label indicating date and milestone.
Anti-Slop Rules: No pulsating cartoon dots; use subtle border highlights and clean monospaced year typography.

Best For: Fast-moving tech startups wanting a punchy, interactive chronology without vertical page bloat.
Layout Structure: Horizontal scroll container with snap-x alignment. Progress line connecting chronological nodes horizontally. Navigation arrow triggers with progress bar indicator.
Typography Specs: Year: text-2xl font-mono font-extrabold text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-base font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed.
Key Components: Horizontal track, active stage indicator, prev/next buttons, stage cards with consistent 320px width.
Responsive Behavior: Smooth touch-swipe horizontal scroll on mobile with pagination dots.
Accessibility: Scrollable region marked with role='region' and aria-label='Company Timeline Carousel'; keyboard arrows navigate items.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure cards do not truncate text on small screens; enforce minimum readable height.

Best For: Design studios, venture studios, and architecture firms wanting clean, sophisticated typography without graphics.
Layout Structure: Clean stacked list with 1px top/bottom border dividers. Left col: Year (text-mono). Center col: Milestone headline and narrative. Right col: Key stat or partner logo.
Typography Specs: Year: text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]. Headline: text-xl font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]. Summary: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: 3-column grid row, hover highlight, subtle border separators, monospaced timestamp.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks to 2-column or single column on mobile with year above headline.
Accessibility: Uses <dl>, <dt> (Year), and <dd> (Description) for accessible definition list semantics.
Anti-Slop Rules: Zero floating badges or emoji decorations; pure typographic craft and strict alignment.

Best For: Agencies and tech companies with 4 to 6 clear internal philosophies guiding their work.
Layout Structure: 3x2 grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Each card: oversized monospaced number (01, 02, ...), bold belief title, 3-sentence operational explanation.
Typography Specs: Number: text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)]. Title: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Card surface, monospaced index, title, operational rationale, subtle bottom accent line on hover.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop with stretch alignment.
Accessibility: Semantic <section> with <h3> for each principle title; contrast ratio exceeds 7:1.
Anti-Slop Rules: No cliché stock buzzwords ('We innovate with synergy'); principles must describe actual trade-offs and behaviors.

Best For: Mission-driven companies where the founders' point of view is the primary differentiator.
Layout Structure: 2-column container. Left (5 cols): Sticky founder manifesto statement in large editorial serif font. Right (7 cols): Expandable accordion detailing how each belief is executed.
Typography Specs: Manifesto: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium leading-relaxed. Accordion title: text-lg font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed.
Key Components: Sticky manifesto column, accessible accordion rows, plus/minus indicator, quote attribution.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with manifesto statement on top.
Accessibility: <button aria-expanded='false'> on accordion headers with keyboard navigation support.
Anti-Slop Rules: No glowing purple gradient text in the manifesto; maintain clean dark-mode or high-contrast editorial look.

Archetype Name: Asymmetric Bento Grid of Cultural Pillars
Best For: Modern tech brands, creative agencies, and AI companies seeking a visually striking, non-traditional layout.
Layout Structure: 4-card bento grid (2 large span-2 cards + 2 compact cards). Cards mix typography, code/terminal snippets, and concrete behavioral rules.
Typography Specs: Pillar title: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold. Code snippet: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl.
Key Components: Asymmetric grid cells, ambient card borders, code snippet element, metric anchor badge.
Responsive Behavior: Converts to single-column stacked cards on mobile with consistent 16px gap.
Accessibility: Cards have role='region' or <article> with clear heading hierarchy.
Anti-Slop Rules: Bento cards must contain actual substance, not empty decorative gradient filler.

Best For: Companies with high-quality authentic workplace, studio, or offsite photography.
Layout Structure: Asymmetric 5-image collage grid (grid-cols-12 gap-6). Mix of aspect-video hero photo (span-7), vertical portrait (span-5), and bottom panoramic strip.
Typography Specs: Photo caption: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]. Location badge: text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur rounded.
Key Components: Aspect-ratio locked image containers, subtle hover zoom (scale-102 duration-300), location tags, caption overlays.
Responsive Behavior: Converts to 2-column or swipeable photo strip on mobile.
Accessibility: Every has descriptive alt text describing the team context and physical environment.
Anti-Slop Rules: STRICT: Zero generic stock photography (e.g. models in suits high-fiving in glass meeting rooms). Real workplace only.

Best For: Distributed or multi-city agencies and tech platforms with offices in New York, London, Tokyo, etc.
Layout Structure: Full-width dark container with stylized SVG world map graphic. Interactive or pinned hub markers (San Francisco, London, Singapore) displaying local team headcount and local time.
Typography Specs: City name: text-base font-bold. Local time & headcount: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: SVG vector map, pulsing location pins, city card popovers, remote-first manifesto pill.
Responsive Behavior: Map scrolls horizontally or simplifies into a 3-column city card grid on mobile viewports.
Accessibility: City list also provided in an accessible semantic <ul> hidden visually or beneath the map for screen readers.
Anti-Slop Rules: Map pins must be accurate and vector-clean; no pixelated map textures.

Best For: Culture-first companies wanting to highlight how team members actually work and collaborate.
Layout Structure: 3-column card grid. Each card combines a natural photo of a team member in their setup, a direct quote about working norms, and their role.
Typography Specs: Quote: text-base italic leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Role: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--primary)].
Key Components: Authentic portrait, quote text, role label, working style badge (e.g., 'Async / Deep Work Focus').
Responsive Behavior: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns desktop with stretch card heights.
Accessibility: Quotes wrapped in <figure> and <blockquote> with <figcaption> for attribution.
Anti-Slop Rules: No manufactured corporate praise; focus on practical working realities.

Archetype Name: C-Suite Grid with Alumni Credibility Badges
Keywords: leadership, executive-team, c-suite, founders, pedigree, alumni-badges
Best For: High-growth tech startups and top-tier consultancies where leadership background drives enterprise trust.
Layout Structure: 4-column grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Each profile: crisp headshot, executive name, title, and mini previous experience pill strip ('Ex-Stripe', 'Ex-Google', 'MIT').
Typography Specs: Name: text-lg font-bold. Title: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--primary)]. Alumni pill: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Headshot (aspect-[4/5] rounded-2xl), name, title, previous company logos/chips, LinkedIn SVG link.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Headshot alt text includes full name and title; LinkedIn link has accessible aria-label.
Anti-Slop Rules: Consistent portrait lighting and aspect ratios across all photos; no mismatched crops.

Archetype Name: Backed-By Venture Capital & Advisory Board Strip
Best For: Venture-backed companies where investor tier-1 brand backing establishes institutional stability.
Layout Structure: Full-width section with 2-tier layout: Top tier displays Tier-1 VC investor logos (e.g. Sequoia, Accel, YC); Bottom tier displays 4 advisory board quotes.
Typography Specs: Section eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--text-muted)]. Quote: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Monochrome investor logo row, advisor headshots, quote bubbles, partner credentials.
Responsive Behavior: Logos wrap into 2-3 columns on mobile; advisor quotes stack cleanly.
Accessibility: Logo SVGs have title attributes; advisor cards use semantic figure/blockquote.
Anti-Slop Rules: All logos normalized to uniform greyscale height; no full-color competing sponsor banners.

Keywords: architecture, data-pipeline, node-graph, technical-diagram, system-flow, engineering
Best For: Engineering consultancies, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML pipelines, and data platforms.
Layout Structure: Interactive SVG flowchart container (min-h-[400px] rounded-2xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] p-8). 3-stage visual nodes (Ingestion -> Processing -> Output/APIs) connected by animated directional paths.
Typography Specs: Node title: text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]. Metric badge: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400. Subtitle: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: SVG vector nodes, dashed bezier connecting lines, protocol labels (gRPC, Kafka, REST), inspect drawer on click.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scroll with pan-zoom controls on tablet/mobile, or stacks into 3 linear stages.
Accessibility: SVG has role='img' and aria-label; full text alternative provided in accessible <ul> for screen readers.
Anti-Slop Rules: No fake 3D isometric clipart; clean 2D engineering blueprint styling with crisp 1px borders.

Best For: Enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, and full-stack software development services.
Layout Structure: Vertical stack of 4 horizontal layers: Presentation Layer, Core Logic / API Layer, Data & Storage Layer, Security & Observability Layer. Each layer expands to reveal technical specifications.
Typography Specs: Layer label: text-sm font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[var(--text-primary)]. Technology pills: text-xs font-mono bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 px-2 py-1 rounded.
Key Components: Collapsible layer bands, security badge callouts, compliance seals, expandable spec panel.
Responsive Behavior: Layers stack vertically on all devices with 100% width.
Accessibility: Semantic <section> with <button aria-expanded> for layer details.
Anti-Slop Rules: No glowing purple gradient borders; maintain structured enterprise blueprint aesthetics.

Best For: Agencies and consultancies that pride themselves on rigorous project governance and risk mitigation.
Layout Structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 py-16). Left (5 cols): 4-phase sequential methodology (Discovery, Architecture, Sprint Build, QA & Handover). Right (7 cols): Dynamic card updating to show tangible deliverables per phase.
Typography Specs: Phase number: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Title: text-xl font-bold. Deliverable item: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Phase progress indicator, active phase tab, deliverable asset list, client involvement estimate badge.
Responsive Behavior: Converts to 4 stacked accordion items on mobile.
Accessibility: role='tablist' with role='tab' and aria-controls for the deliverable preview panel.
Anti-Slop Rules: Clearly state actual technical artifacts, not vague promises like 'synergistic transformation'.

Best For: Product studios and software shops detailing exact handover artifacts (Design tokens, Figma system, Clean CI/CD, Documentation).
Layout Structure: Centered max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 space-y-4. Stack of 4 broad categories (Design System, Backend Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps & Infrastructure), each opening to a checklist of exact deliverables.
Typography Specs: Category title: text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Deliverable name: text-sm font-medium. Format pill: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Accordion trigger, artifact count chip ('8 artifacts'), checkmark list, export format tags (.tsx, .fig, .tf).
Responsive Behavior: Full width on mobile with touch-friendly 48px trigger height.
Accessibility: Standard accordion pattern with aria-expanded and keyboard Space/Enter toggle.
Anti-Slop Rules: Specify file formats and licensing; no vague lists of 'good designs'.

Best For: Managed service providers, retainer agencies, and dev shops with strict delivery commitments.
Layout Structure: Full-width table with 5 columns: Service Component, Typical Turnaround, Weekly Dev Allocation, Included Revisions, Testing Coverage Guarantee.
Typography Specs: Table header: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Cell text: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)].
Key Components: Semantic <table>, SLA guarantee pill, revision policy badge, coverage badge (>90% unit test).
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal swipe container on mobile with sticky first column.
Accessibility: Proper th scope='col' and scope='row' markup; contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1.
Anti-Slop Rules: SLA numbers must be defensible and clear; no ambiguous 'unlimited everything'.

Best For: Modern agency websites allowing prospects to select their exact needs before requesting a proposal.
Layout Structure: Interactive 3-column selection matrix. Prospects toggle required modules (e.g., Auth & RBAC, Stripe Billing, Realtime WebSockets, Admin Dashboard) and view an estimated delivery timeline.
Typography Specs: Module title: text-base font-semibold. Timeline readout: text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)].
Key Components: Selectable module cards with checkboxes, estimated timeline meter, 'Generate Scope Brief' CTA button.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column on mobile with sticky bottom timeline readout.
Accessibility: role='checkbox' with aria-checked states; keyboard toggle.
Anti-Slop Rules: Estimates must state they are preliminary pending discovery; no misleading auto-commitments.

Keywords: tech-stack, frameworks, tools, languages, cloud-providers, monochromatic-icons
Best For: Developer-focused dev shops and SaaS software agencies where technical stack choices dictate vendor suitability.
Layout Structure: 4-column category grid: Frontend & Mobile (Next.js, React, React Native), Backend & APIs (Node, Go, Python, GraphQL), Databases & Caching (PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse), Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS, Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes).
Typography Specs: Category title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Tech name: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Subtle card containers, 24x24 SVG technology icons, version compatibility notes, category headers.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Each tech item has descriptive text (never just an unlabelled icon).
Anti-Slop Rules: All technology logos must be normalized to clean monochromatic SVGs; no chaotic multi-color logo circus.

Best For: Agencies holding official cloud and software partner credentials (AWS Advanced Partner, Vercel Partner, Stripe Expert).
Layout Structure: Centered horizontal card strip with 4 high-trust partner cards. Each card displays official partner badge, certified engineer headcount, and direct credential verification link.
Typography Specs: Partner title: text-base font-bold. Certified count: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400.
Key Components: Official vector partner badge, certification badge, certified engineer count, external credential link.
Responsive Behavior: 2x2 grid on mobile, 4-column row on desktop.
Accessibility: External links have aria-label='Verify AWS Partnership credential (opens in new tab)'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Only show legitimate, verifiable partner credentials; no self-made fake gold awards.

Best For: Enterprise integrations, iPaaS, and software platforms supporting 30+ integrations.
Layout Structure: Filter pill bar (All, CRM, Payments, Data, Cloud) + live search input. Below: 6x4 compact icon grid updating instantly on filter/search without page reload.
Typography Specs: Search input: text-sm font-medium. Pill text: text-xs font-semibold. Tech title: text-xs font-medium.
Key Components: Search input, category pills, compact technology badge cards, zero-results fallback state.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scroll for category pills on mobile; 3-column grid for tech cards.
Accessibility: Search input has explicit aria-label='Filter supported integrations'; results announce count.
Anti-Slop Rules: Fast client-side filtering with zero layout jump; empty state has helpful contact CTA.

Best For: Companies catering to multiple regulated industries with distinct compliance and functional needs.
Layout Structure: Top tab bar (Fintech & Banking, Healthcare & HIPAA, Enterprise SaaS, AI & Data). Selecting a tab reveals an industry hero card with sector-specific architecture, compliance badges, and case study link.
Typography Specs: Tab label: text-sm font-semibold. Sector title: text-2xl font-bold. Compliance pill: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Segmented tab bar, industry solution card, compliance badge strip, featured client quote.
Responsive Behavior: Tabs convert to horizontal swipe list on mobile with snap-x scrolling.
Accessibility: role='tablist' with aria-selected states and arrow key navigation.
Anti-Slop Rules: Industry sections must address real regulatory requirements (e.g. HIPAA, PCI-DSS Level 1), not generic copy.

Best For: B2B enterprise platforms selling to multiple internal stakeholders with different purchasing criteria.
Layout Structure: 3-column card grid: 'For Technical Leaders (CTO/VP Eng)', 'For Product & Growth Leaders (CPO/VP Growth)', 'For Financial & Executive Leaders (CEO/CFO)'.
Typography Specs: Persona title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-lg font-bold. Value bullet: text-sm.
Key Components: Stakeholder icon, core outcome headline, 3 concrete value metrics (e.g. '50% less tech debt', '2x release velocity').
Responsive Behavior: 1 column mobile, 3 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Semantic <article> per persona with clear H3 heading.
Anti-Slop Rules: Speak directly to each stakeholder's concrete metrics; avoid universal vague platitudes.

Best For: B2B SaaS, enterprise consulting, and agencies seeking high conversion with minimal form friction.
Layout Structure: 2-column container (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16 items-start). Left (5 cols): Trust column ('What happens when you reach out', response time badge, enterprise client logo strip, VIP customer testimonial quote). Right (7 cols): Clean 5-field card form (Work Email, Full Name, Company Size dropdown, Project Scope, Submit button with micro-guarantee).
Typography Specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Form labels: text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Inputs: text-sm py-2.5 px-3.5.
Key Components: Structured form card, work email domain validator, company size selector, trust bullets, response SLA badge ('We reply in < 2 hours'), submit button with loading spinner.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline and trust metrics above form card.
Accessibility: Inputs use explicit <label for='...'> tags, aria-required='true', aria-describedby for errors, focus-visible outline with 2px offset.
Anti-Slop Rules: STRICT: Maximum 5 fields; never ask for phone numbers on step 1 unless strictly requested. Zero generic captcha walls.

Best For: High-ticket services ($15k+) where qualified scoping is required before an executive consultation.
Layout Structure: Centered max-w-2xl mx-auto py-16. Top progress bar (Step 1: Your Goals -> Step 2: Timeline & Budget -> Step 3: Contact Details). Each step reveals 3-4 interactive pill buttons rather than text inputs.
Typography Specs: Step indicator: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Step question: text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Option pill: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Progress step bar, selectable option pills with check indicators, animated slide/fade step transition (opacity duration-150), Back and Next buttons.
Responsive Behavior: Full width pills on mobile with 48px tap targets.
Accessibility: role='form' with aria-live='polite' step announcements for screen readers; keyboard Arrow key navigation between options.
Anti-Slop Rules: Never animate with jarring layout height jumps; step transitions use opacity only with fixed min-height container.

Best For: Founder-led agencies and agile teams where booking a direct 30-min discovery call is the fastest path to closing.
Layout Structure: 2-column split. Left: Host profile (portrait photo, executive bio, meeting agenda, 'What to prepare'). Right: Embedded Cal.com / Calendly calendar widget with time zone detection and available slot picker.
Typography Specs: Host name: text-lg font-bold. Meeting title: text-xl font-bold. Agenda items: text-sm leading-relaxed.
Key Components: Host avatar (aspect-square rounded-2xl), agenda bullet list, responsive iframe container, direct calendar link fallback button.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks on mobile with host details above the calendar embed.
Accessibility: Iframe has descriptive title='Select a date and time for a 30-minute discovery consultation'; full keyboard trap avoidance.
Anti-Slop Rules: Must include a direct external booking link below the embed in case user ad-blockers block third-party iframes.

Best For: Companies with physical offices in multiple major metropolitan markets (e.g. SF, NYC, London, Tokyo).
Layout Structure: 3 or 4-column card grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-12). Each card features city photography thumbnail, local address, local time clock, and Google Maps directions link.
Typography Specs: City name: text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Local time: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--primary)]. Address: text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: City photo (rounded-xl object-cover), local time indicator, physical address, direct email link, external map pin icon.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on tablet, 3-4 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Cards use semantic <article> with clear H3 city names; external map links include aria-label.
Anti-Slop Rules: Use authentic city studio photos or clean architectural crops; no generic flag emojis.

Archetype Name: Global Stylized Vector Map with Office Pins
Best For: Global enterprise platforms and multinational consultancies highlighting international coverage.
Layout Structure: Full-width dark container featuring high-contrast monochrome SVG world map. Interactive glowing pins over active regions. Clicking a pin reveals office contact details.
Typography Specs: Region title: text-sm font-bold. Pin popover text: text-xs font-mono.
Key Components: Monochrome SVG world map, pulse SVG pin markers, interactive popover cards, fallback accessible text list.
Responsive Behavior: Map scrolls horizontally on mobile or displays a stacked city directory list underneath.
Accessibility: Visual map paired with accessible HTML directory list for screen readers.
Anti-Slop Rules: Crisp vector SVG map with zero blurry raster image backgrounds.

Best For: Setting clear communication expectations and eliminating the fear that inquiries go into an unanswered black hole.
Layout Structure: Full-width subtle strip py-8 border-y border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--surface-subtle)]. 3-column layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 text-center).
Typography Specs: Commitment title: text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Description: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
Key Components: Clock SVG icon ('< 2-Hour Response Time'), Shield SVG icon ('Strict NDA & Security Privacy'), Chat SVG icon ('Direct Slack Channel for Enterprise').
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with 16px gap.
Accessibility: Semantic <section> with aria-label='Our Communication Commitments'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Keep commitments realistic; specify business hours if 24/7 coverage is not actually supported.

Archetype Name: Dual-Track Sales vs Support Routing Banner
Best For: Preventing customer support tickets from cluttering the sales inquiry pipeline.
Layout Structure: Split card container. Left half: 'Looking to hire us or buy? Stay on this page.' Right half: 'Already a customer? Visit our 24/7 Help Center or Submit a Ticket' with quick links.
Typography Specs: Headline: text-base font-semibold. Link: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--primary)] underline.
Key Components: Split container, support portal button, status page indicator ('All Systems Operational').
Responsive Behavior: Stacks into 2 separate cards on mobile.
Accessibility: Both links have descriptive text avoiding generic 'Click here'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Clean subtle borders; no screaming alert banners or bright yellow caution colors.

Best For: Highlighting a major flagship client success story with undeniable ROI and visual polish.
Layout Structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-20 items-center). Left (6 cols): Client logo, category eyebrow chip, punchy outcome headline, 3-metric ROI badge strip (+340% Pipeline, 45ms P99 Latency, 6-Week Delivery), 'Read Full Story ->' primary CTA. Right (6 cols): High-res responsive device mockup frame (MacBook + iPhone) with subtle ambient glow.
Typography Specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)]. Stat numerals: text-2xl font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400.
Key Components: Client vector logo, metric pill badges, primary case study CTA button, multi-device mockup container with 1px border.
Responsive Behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline and metrics above mockup.
Accessibility: Device mockup image has descriptive alt text describing the client application UI; CTA has clear destination aria-label.
Anti-Slop Rules: Metrics must be qualified and defensible; zero generic round stats like '100% better'.

Best For: High-craft digital product studios, branding agencies, and 3D visual production houses.
Layout Structure: Full-width container (aspect-[21/9] or min-h-[520px] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative mx-auto max-w-7xl my-8). Background: looping muted MP4 video reel or high-res photography. Foreground card (bottom-left): Client name, project scope, key quote, and 'Explore Project' button.
Typography Specs: Overlay title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white. Scope chips: text-xs font-mono text-slate-300 bg-black/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded.
Key Components: HTML5 video element with playsinline and autoplay, gradient scrim mask, floating glassmorphism metadata card, play/pause toggle.
Responsive Behavior: Video aspect ratio adjusts to aspect-video on mobile; card sits cleanly below or inside.
Accessibility: Includes visible play/pause button for WCAG 2.2 Pause/Stop/Hide rule; video is muted by default.
Anti-Slop Rules: Must provide a fallback poster image for slow connections; video must be compressed under 4MB.

Best For: Enterprise engineering consultancies where cumulative track record outweighs single visual projects.
Layout Structure: Single column max-w-4xl mx-auto py-24 text-center. Giant editorial headline announcing cumulative scale (e.g. '$4.2B in client value shipped across 85+ production deployments'), followed by a 3-badge proof strip.
Typography Specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--text-muted)]. H1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-serif font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-[1.12].
Key Components: Oversized typography headline, client logo row, category quick-jump anchors.
Responsive Behavior: Fluid typography clamping preserving line breaks on mobile.
Accessibility: Headings follow strict hierarchy H1 -> H2; text contrast exceeds 7:1.
Anti-Slop Rules: Zero cartoon emojis or floating sparkles; pure typographic authority.

Archetype Name: Multi-Pill Filterable Grid with Impact Badges
Best For: Agencies and dev shops with 12 to 30+ varied case studies spanning multiple industries and tech stacks.
Layout Structure: Sticky filter pill header (All, Fintech, Healthtech, AI & Data, B2B SaaS). Below: 2 or 3-column responsive card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Each card: high-res project image (aspect-[16/10]), client logo, deliverables tag, bold impact metric badge (e.g. '+240% ARR'), and case title.
Typography Specs: Filter pill: text-xs font-semibold px-3.5 py-1.5. Card title: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Metric tag: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full.
Key Components: Filter pill bar with active indicator, image card with hover zoom (scale-102 duration-200), client logo chip, impact metric pill, tag list.
Responsive Behavior: Filter pills scroll horizontally with snap-x on mobile; grid collapses to single column.
Accessibility: Filter bar uses role='tablist' with aria-selected states; filter updates announce item count via aria-live='polite'.
Anti-Slop Rules: Zero slow animated reflows; filter uses fast CSS opacity/visibility transitions with zero layout shifts.

Archetype Name: Asymmetric Editorial Masonry with Embedded Quotes
Best For: Award-winning creative design studios showcasing varied aspect ratios and typography.
Layout Structure: Asymmetric 2-column masonry grid. Standard project cards alternate with full-quote cards (large quote from client CEO) and video preview cards.
Typography Specs: Title: text-2xl font-bold font-serif. Tag: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Quote: text-lg italic.
Key Components: Asymmetric card heights, embedded client testimonial cards, hover video loops, clean link arrows.
Responsive Behavior: Collapses to single column on mobile while maintaining quote cards between projects.
Accessibility: Quote cards use semantic <figure> and <blockquote>; images have rich descriptive alt text.
Anti-Slop Rules: Ensure image cards maintain consistent contrast and alignment; avoid unreadable text over photos.

Best For: Enterprise systems consultancies, cybersecurity firms, and technical architecture teams.
Layout Structure: Full-width searchable table with live search input. Columns: Client & Sector, Scope of Work, Primary Deliverable, Verified Impact Metric, Link / Case Study.
Typography Specs: Search input: text-sm font-medium. Table headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Rows: text-sm font-medium.
Key Components: Live search filter, column sorting triggers, verified metric pills, PDF download / case link buttons.
Responsive Behavior: Horizontal scroll container on mobile with sticky client column.
Accessibility: Semantic <table> with th scope='col', sortable buttons announce direction via aria-sort.
Anti-Slop Rules: Crisp 1px borders; zero bloated decorative empty space.

Archetype Name: 3-Column Pull Quote Grid with Enterprise Headshots
Best For: Reinforcing project outcomes with direct quotes from verified C-suite stakeholders.
Layout Structure: 3-column card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16). Each card: verified client avatar, executive name and title, company logo chip, 3-sentence quote on tangible project impact.
Typography Specs: Quote text: text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Executive name: text-sm font-semibold. Title: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)].
Key Components: Avatar photo (rounded-full 44x44), company logo SVG, quote block, LinkedIn profile link icon.
Responsive Behavior: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns desktop.
Accessibility: Semantic <figure> and <blockquote>; avatar has alt text.
Anti-Slop Rules: Quotes must reference specific project results; no generic 'They were great to work with'.

Best For: Highlighting an exceptional marquee quote from a globally recognized Fortune 500 partner.
Layout Structure: Full-width elevated card (py-16 px-8 sm:px-16 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center max-w-5xl mx-auto my-12).
Typography Specs: Quote: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Attribution: text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)].
Key Components: Marquee client logo, oversized quotation mark, executive signature or headshot, video interview trigger button.
Responsive Behavior: Typography scales smoothly via fluid clamp; quote wraps cleanly.
Accessibility: Quote wrapped in semantic blockquote with cite attribute.
Anti-Slop Rules: Clean monochromatic logo; no bright clashing client brand colors.
